comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (81.82%) to P19 F: 36%, T: 18%, R: 36%. Chemical modification: C-terminal amidation. Activity: active against E. coli 25922 or UB1005 (MIC 8-16 uM), P. aeruginosa 27853 (MIC 32 uM), S. epidermidis 12228 (MIC 32 uM), S.aureus 29213 (MIC 128 uM), S. aureus MRSA43300 (MIC 64 uM), L. rhamnosus 1.0385 (MIC 8 uM), L.plantarum 7469 (MIC >128 uM), C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086 (MIC 2 uM), C. parapsilosis CGMCC 2.3989 (MIC 2 uM). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: 3.2% hemolysis at 128 uM (HC50>128 uM), poorly hemo.lytic.
